description: Western India Plywoods Limited manufactures and sells hardboard, plywood, and compreg wood products in India and internationally. The company offers fire retardant, resin surfaced shuttering, marine, and boiling water-resistant plywood; hard boards, such as standard hardboard, oil tempered, and perforated; densified woods, including compreg slats, moulded seats, WIPCHECK, WIPBEAR, WIPROC, WIP filter plates, WIPCOM, WIPLAM, and WIPWOOD; softwoods; furniture; doors; and WIPRESS, a hard and rigid board. It also provides value-added products. It serves customers automobiles customers, and packaging industry and construction companies. The Company was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Kannur, India.
